Class XmlUtteranceType

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.session.io.xml.v2_0.XmlUtteranceType
public class XmlUtteranceType extends Object
 <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><a xmlns="https://phon.ca/ns/session" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" href="https://talkbank.org/manuals/CHAT.html#Utterances">CHAT manual section on
                     this topic...</a>

Java class for utteranceType complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="utteranceType">
   <complexContent>
     <restriction base="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}anyType">
       <sequence>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}linker" maxOccurs="unbounded" minOccurs="0"/>
         <choice maxOccurs="unbounded">
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}w"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}g"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}pg"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}quotation"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}pause"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}internal-media"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}freecode"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}e"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}s"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}tagMarker"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}overlap-point"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}underline"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}italic"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}long-feature"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}nonvocal"/>
         </choice>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}t" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}postcode" maxOccurs="unbounded" minOccurs="0"/>
         <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}media" minOccurs="0"/>
         <choice maxOccurs="unbounded" minOccurs="0">
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}k"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}error"/>
         </choice>
       </sequence>
       <attribute ref="{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}lang"/>
     </restriction>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>

  • Method Details

    • getLinker

      public List<XmlLinkerType> getLinker()
      Gets the value of the linker property.

      This accessor method returns a reference to the live list, not a snapshot. Therefore any modification you make to the returned list will be present inside the Jakarta XML Binding object. This is why there is not a set method for the linker property.

      For example, to add a new item, do as follows: 

          getLinker().add(newItem);

      Objects of the following type(s) are allowed in the list XmlLinkerType

    • getWOrGOrPg

      public List<Object> getWOrGOrPg()
      Gets the value of the wOrGOrPg property.

      This accessor method returns a reference to the live list, not a snapshot. Therefore any modification you make to the returned list will be present inside the Jakarta XML Binding object. This is why there is not a set method for the wOrGOrPg property.

      For example, to add a new item, do as follows: 

          getWOrGOrPg().add(newItem);

      Objects of the following type(s) are allowed in the list XmlWType XmlGroupType XmlPhoneticGroupType XmlQuotationType XmlPauseType XmlMediaType XmlFreecodeType XmlEventType XmlSeparatorType XmlTagMarkerType XmlOverlapPointType XmlUnderlineType XmlItalicType XmlLongFeatureType XmlNonvocalType
